title: Restore verified access to Project 10 for #737 synchronization
body:
<!-- issue-737-remediation:R737-ACCESS:v1 -->

The configured GH_PROJECT_TOKEN binding reports ready, but both normal GitHub authentication and the configured Project credential return FORBIDDEN / Resource not accessible by integration for Project 10. Read-only evidence: docs/planning/issue-737/evidence/project-access.json at main 4821378. Repository issue/PR access works; credential readiness does not establish Project authorization.

- [x] Restore an authenticated read of Project 10, all managed fields/items and saved-view configuration, either through corrected credential routing or the portable local package under the owner account.
- [x] Review the concrete live before/after plan and retain its digest before any Project writes.
- [x] Apply the approved delta and independently read back fields, item membership and view filters/grouping/sorting.
- [x] Retain exact commands and non-secret receipts; do not post credentials or treat offline tests as publication evidence.

This is a Phase 3 publication prerequisite, not a runtime failure. #737 stays open until authenticated publication is verified. No new token is requested by this issue, and no phase gate is approved.

Accountable owner: dhar174. Technical review: Codex. Human acceptance: dhar174. Coordination: #737 under D031. Existing parent/dependency requirements remain intact. Phase: 3.


<!-- issue-737-authenticated-readback:D033:v1 -->
## Verified publication prerequisite completed

The owner-authenticated initial Project 10 inspection passed at 2026-10-24T02:43:39.646747+00:00. Both complete uploaded files match the owner's byte counts/SHA-256 hashes and independently pass the merged publisher's receipt verifier. All332 managed rows,12 fields and six delivery views match;333 issue guards,24 candidate heads/states and merged main match both source reads and the coordinator's fresh source recheck. Full unrelated-state preservation is verified.

[Immutable original files, command, hashes and independent verification](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/blob/c7a070ba0a882bf45205a2dd3ff37e7e749d17ee/docs/planning/issue-737-publication-readback/README.md). Plan approval digest: `10db84806f23ad0e8d52a5f7fc723aae9835108873c2f64f4971f3a9381db1d3`.

The reviewed plan contains zero operations; the board already matches the desired publication. Therefore no apply command/checkpoint was needed or run. Fresh inspection exited0 with zero remaining differences and zero GitHub mutations. The third checklist item is satisfied by this verified existing state, not by an unexecuted write.

Close #806 as completed under the conditional D032/D033 authorization. #737 acceptance reconciliation follows; the resulting final readiness still needs a fresh reviewed plan and independent owner-local readback. #738 remains OPEN/Pending and no runtime requirement or phase gate is approved.
